code_facts: world_model/pipeline.py exposes history_frames, history_conds, future_conds and calls a diffusion video predictor
world_model/server.py exposes the predictor over a websocket interface
the checkout includes LIBERO and Robomimic environment code and the Wan/CogVideo model implementations
missing_for_short_native_run: local checkpoint under world_model/data/ckpts is absent
model weights/base Wan files are not included
planner demo depends on a separate server and large model downloads
candidate_boundary: The action-condition video/pose path is a possible future carrier, but an alignment or condition-spoofing claim would require a concrete legal external attack and must be distinguished from input/protocol corruption.
decision: Do not download large weights or start GPU. Keep as a future carrier only.
